channel.title: Software and IT services: Korean small and mid-cap filings
channel.description: New filings from Korean small and mid-cap companies in the software and it services sector.

item.title: Itoxi: Itoxi filed an objection on Nov 16, 2026 to the Corporate Review Committee's Oct 26 decision to delist its shares.
Itoxi: Itoxi's quarterly report shows revenue below KRW 300 million for the latest quarter, adding a ground for KOSDAQ listing eligibility review.
BRIDGETECCorp: Bridgetec signed a KRW 5.26bn contract with KT to rebuild BC Card's call center consultation system.
Itcencts: ITEN CTS subsidiary C Platform will absorb its wholly owned subsidiary 2KM Systems in a no-new-share merger, effective 2026-12-31.
Shinsegae Information & Communication: Shinsegae I&C's Q3 2026 consolidated revenue was KRW 176.9bn, operating profit KRW 16.2bn, up 29.03% year on year.
XIIlab: 씨이랩 (Xiilab) board approved a KRW 10.0bn zero-coupon private convertible bond on Nov 6, 2026, for working capital.
